scope: EXT-F-1012-T07/T08/T09 Showcase Prepare and Snapshot; source-only audit of 084fe593
verification: Source trace only. No test, build, browser, or native acceptance was run under this lane's resource constraint.

path_inventory.prepare: PrepareTab's three independent checkbox states are passed to usePagePrep.run; usePagePrep calls preparePage(tab.id, config), which merges defaults and injects preparePageInPage through chrome.scripting.executeScript (src/features/showcase/tabs/PrepareTab.tsx:6-14,30-46; src/hooks/use-page-prep.ts:24-40; src/lib/data-pattern/page-prep.ts:223-240).
path_inventory.snapshot: SnapshotTab calls useExtraction('og_meta').run({}); runMode injects ogMetaMode.runInPage and requires an array result. The extractor reads document title, URL, metadata and JSON-LD and returns one row; ResultPreview renders it (src/features/showcase/tabs/SnapshotTab.tsx:7-41; src/hooks/use-extraction.ts:88-120; src/lib/data-pattern/run-pattern.ts:104-123; src/lib/data-pattern/modes/og-meta.ts:17-76).
path_inventory.page_identity: Both hooks consume useActiveTab, whose identity comprises tab id, URL and title; usePagePrep invalidates on id/URL and useExtraction invalidates and guards results on id/URL (src/hooks/use-active-tab.ts:3-26; src/hooks/use-page-prep.ts:16-22; src/hooks/use-extraction.ts:47-65,88-119).

findings.confidence: deterministic source defect; native occurrence unverified
findings.trigger: For a resolved chrome.scripting.executeScript call whose result is [] or whose first result is absent, click Prepare.
findings.expected: The page did not return a preparation report; show a visible failure with a retry remedy.
findings.actual_by_code: preparePage substitutes a zero-count, zero-duration report. usePagePrep stores it and PrepareTab displays a green 'Prepared in 0ms' success.
findings.minimal_shared_repair: Validate the injected report at the scripting boundary and throw an actionable error instead of synthesizing success, matching run-pattern.ts extractionRows. Census all executeScript callers for the same silent-fallback pattern.

findings.confidence: deterministic source defect; native occurrence unverified
findings.trigger: Complete Prepare once on page A, then run it again on the same page and make chrome.scripting.executeScript reject (for example, revoke access before the second click).
findings.expected: The failed attempt shows its error without presenting the old success as the current result.
findings.actual_by_code: run clears error but never clears report; on rejection it sets error and retains the prior report. PrepareTab renders the error and green success report together.
findings.minimal_shared_repair: Clear the previous report when a new run starts, as useExtraction clears previous rows at run start; keep its visible error behavior.

findings.confidence: source-supported deterministic ordering; native reproduction needed
findings.trigger: Start a long Prepare on page A, navigate the active tab to page B with a different URL, let the invalidation effect clear the old report, then let the A promise resolve.
findings.expected: Page B cannot display A's preparation report.
findings.actual_by_code: The A continuation unconditionally calls setReport after the page-change effect clears it; no generation or page-key guard blocks the late result. A failed late run likewise writes A's error on B.
findings.minimal_shared_repair: Use a tab/document generation and run-sequence guard in usePagePrep, following the guarded useExtraction pattern. Include current-document identity for same-URL reloads in the shared active-tab primitive.

non_findings_and_limits: T07: the three toggles have separate state and their booleans reach preparePage via the merged config. No source defect established for the basic option mapping; UI interaction and actual page effects remain unverified.

T09: runMode validates that Snapshot receives an array, useExtraction displays errors and resets rows on tab-id/URL changes, and the button is disabled while running. No deterministic Snapshot defect established in this bounded trace; exact metadata and native busy/error states remain unverified.

A same-tab, same-URL document reload leaves the id/URL page key unchanged, so old results can remain visible. This is a document-identity gap shared by Prepare and Snapshot, but actual behavior across an installed reload was not exercised here.
If useActiveTab has not resolved a tab id, both run hooks return without an error. This is a transient no-op risk; no stable user-visible reproduction was established.
remaining_acceptance: Run native T07-T09 on an ordinary controlled page, including checkbox combinations, a rejected injection, a page change during Prepare, current-page Snapshot field comparison, reload, and service errors.
